subject: Calibration & metrology support for Exide Energy Solutions Ltd (Bengaluru Lithium-ion Cell Manufacturing Giga Factory)
body:
Dear Vijayaraghavan Manian,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am reaching out from Oorja Technical Services in light of your lithium-ion cell manufacturing facility expansion at Devanahalli, Bengaluru Rural. As you scale production and commission new equipment, maintaining high-precision traceable calibration and testing is vital for plant quality compliance.

Oorja Technical Services is an ISO/IEC 17025:2017 accredited laboratory (NABL Certificate CC-3963) providing on-site and in-lab calibration across thermal, mechanical, dimensional, and electrical parameters.

If you are currently evaluating calibration partners for this facility, I would appreciate the opportunity to share our approved scope and schedule a brief introductory discussion.

Referral Note: If you are not the person coordinating calibration/testing activities, could you please guide me to the relevant colleague?

Warm regards,
